title: Separate compact reversible mixed-channel packets from actual word-code recovery
statement: Two reconstructed Visconti word repertoires and a donor-closed random repertoire motivate visibly framed mixed cipher controls over Boccaccio, Villani and Machiavelli. With 15 clean and 15 noisy author cases, mean exact fallback-character recovery is 99.993% and 98.022%, while marked word recovery is 67.53% and 65.18%, versus 41.93% and 38.70% with frequency-only assignment. Overall word recovery is 97.47% and 89.07%. Only two cases in each condition meet the joint fixed gate. All three donor Markov controls meet that gate and the marked-only context test; IID, complete-word-shuffled and no-static-code inputs do not. All 42 paid oracle and blind packets replay their declared plaintext and exact received ciphertext. At 2% noise, every true-plaintext oracle packet costs 12,800–16,152 bits more than the better ciphertext baseline. Every inferred-plaintext packet is 2,056–3,664 bits smaller on those same inputs. The cheaper blind representation can absorb received corruptions and wrong word assignments into its proposed plaintext. Wire reversibility and byte savings therefore fail the intended recovery test on most author controls.
check: Improve independent whole-codeword inference, enlarge donor coverage with held code repertoires, and evaluate multiple genre and noise variants under the same search budget. Separate literal from marked recovery and require independent language evidence against matched Markov and no-word-key controls. Replay exact known-plaintext costs for all chosen channels and use a reviewed declarative family before any manuscript evaluation.

methods.design: Use the documented 12-word R5323 inventory and first 12 lexical targets from the R5324 reconstruction. Only target-word membership is borrowed. Letters and whole-code IDs are independently permuted in the planted keys. The modern marked namespace and token boundaries are visible to the learner. Fit on 8,000 ciphertext tokens, select letter restart on the next 2,000, and measure on the next 4,000. Fit word and spelling likelihoods from a separate donor, Dante. The top 128 donor word candidates exclude any held author data.
methods.fit: Fit within-word character bigrams and trigrams with separate boundary marks, downweighting the top-48 donor word types to .75 of their frequency. Five bijective annealing restarts with 2,800 swaps each select by independent ciphertext window likelihood. Dict candidates maximize an injective assignment with a count prior, an explicit penalty when the same word is read in the literal channel, and a fixed adjacent-literal word-bigram lift. Hold the selected dictionary fixed for the final stream.
methods.nulls: Compare with count-only decoder, a true key on IID or reference-Markov writing, a true key on order-shuffled author writing, and a separate code-only shuffle within each interval. In the last case whole-code identities and positions retain their frequencies but the planted relation to author tokens is scrambled. Assess held adjacent marked-versus-literal edges against 39 masked marked-word shuffles with unknown predictions fixed.
methods.byte_accounting: Framed zlib baselines include normalized plaintext, a preset donor dictionary plaintext channel, received ciphertext and a compressed vocabulary plus ciphertext index stream. Hybrid packets explicitly include plaintext and literal dictionary rows, letter permutation rank stored in 96 bits (89-bit information value), headers, and indexed residuals needed to reconstruct the exact input. The external 32 KiB donor preset is shared and identified by a paid SHA-256 field for both relevant channels. Charging transmission of that preset would add 262,144 bits. The standalone byte reader reconstructs packet shape, keys, plaintext proposal and received ciphertext.
methods.search_cost: 14,000 letter swap proposals per case, with five validation candidates. A 3-bit restart selector suffices among the five fixed returns if replaying the shared deterministic search. The actual packets pay the resulting keys explicitly and do not also bill a duplicate selector. Dictionary scoring uses one rectangular assignment per contender and a common fixed donor vocabulary.

limitations: The inventories are extracted from reconstructed historical sources. The actual historic homophones, syllables, nulls, sign ambiguities and grouping are absent in the toy channel. The word candidates omit que, and in the second repertoire also et; support varies between words. Each author contributes correlated keys and paired clean/noisy observations. The reference word Markov generator intentionally matches the fitted model. The blind packet verifies its own proposal, which can differ from the planted truth. The reported corpus, ciphertext and recovery cases use only public source works.

present_frozen_design.scope: Public historical Italian controls only. Known visible namespace and token boundaries; synthetic keys
present_frozen_design.precedent: Use the 12 word-code targets documented in Visconti 1446 as set A, and the first 12 unambiguous standalone lexical entries of the 1447 reconstruction in listed order as set B. Simulated symbols are independently permuted Latin letters and visibly framed marked IDs. Homophones, nulls, syllables, and historical typography are outside the experimental channel.
present_frozen_design.data: Fit donor character and word models on first 60,000 normalized Dante tokens. Use independent author streams on windows [2000,16000), of which 8,000 fit ciphertext, 2,000 select letter restarts, and 4,000 score. The donor never includes evaluation authors. Period source membership sets are used only in plant oracle. The learner sees top 128 donor words, not membership or target words.
present_frozen_design.literal_search: Bijective letter swaps, 5 restarts with 2,800 proposals each. Start with donor fallback frequency for restart zero; later restart seeds either perturb 7 swaps or randomized. Use donor within-word trigram scores, with hierarchical character backoff. Discount donor candidate words by 0.75 in spelling fit, reflecting K-of-48 fallback selection. Select restart on ciphertext selection window only.
present_frozen_design.dictionary_search: Use full fitted spelling decoding and identify the two known token namespaces. One-to-one assignment to top-128 donor words using Poisson frequency, fixed Penalty of 2 bits per exact literal occurrence and adjacent-to-literal bigram lift compared with donor frequency. Primary context weight 1. Compare frequency-only exact assignment. Exclude all marked-to-marked pairs from fitting and held context test.
positive: Two historical membership sets, two independent code assignments each per author, clean and 2% noise
Choose 12 of top 48 donor words by separate planted oracle, clean and 2% noise
present_frozen_design.noise: Independent 2% replacement per literal ciphertext glyph or per marked code ID; retain marker and boundaries
controls: Shuffle marked IDs independently within each of fit, selection, and evaluation intervals to destroy static keyed relation while preserving position and type counts
Shuffle complete held-author word sequence, then encode with a genuine planted key
Sample donor first-order word Markov with 8% unigram refresh
present_frozen_design.threshold: .95 exact fallback plaintext character rate, .80 exact marked target token rate and .90 exact overall plaintext words jointly. These calibrated recovery targets have separate held marked-context rank based on 39 within-mask shuffles.
present_frozen_design.accounting: Losslessly compare framed zlib exact plaintext, plaintext compressed with explicitly identified shared donor dictionary, raw ciphertext zlib and paid ciphertext IDs; plus true and inferred hybrid packets with explicit row, letter and word keys, framing and exact residuals. Separate byte costs from logical search budget and order evidence.
present_frozen_design.notes: No full historical decipherment, borrowed readings, hidden Voynich pages or implicit free dictionary.

"""Blind recovery of a typed historical-style toy nomenclator."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from math import ceil, exp, log, log2
from pathlib import Path
from random import Random
from statistics import mean

import numpy as np
from vs.refcorpus import normalize, strip_gutenberg
from wire import ABC, MARK, baseline, decode_words, encode_words, hybrid

FIT, SELECT, TEST=8000,2000,4000
STARTS, PROPOSALS=5,2800
NUM_CANDIDATES=128
VISCONTI={
    'visconti1446': ('que','qua','qui','per','che','con','perche','non','quanto','come','quando','pero'),
    'visconti1447': ('et','que','qui','in','de','con','qua','da','che','cio','per','come'),
}
DONOR_HASH='db0181a5820b1a60b93b87036351cad97b86ea3ab0d725b16dbc6017ab5ccd37'

def digest(path):
    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def idx(w):
    return [ord(c)-97 for c in w]

def spelling_counts(w):
    symbols=[26,26,*idx(w),26]
    return zip(symbols,symbols[1:],symbols[2:])

def character_model(freq, top48):
    tri=np.zeros((27,27,27),dtype=np.float64)
    for w,c in freq.items():
        weight=c*(.75 if w in top48 else 1.)
        for a,b,d in spelling_counts(w):
            tri[a,b,d]+=weight
    big=tri.sum(axis=0)
    uni=big.sum(axis=0)+1.
    uni/=uni.sum()
    pr_big=(big+4.*uni[None,:])/(big.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)+4.)
    prob=(tri+12.*pr_big[None,:,:])/(tri.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)+12.)
    return np.log2(prob),big.sum(axis=0)

def prep_literal(tokens):
    freq=Counter(w for w in tokens if not w.startswith(MARK))
    tri=Counter()
    letters=Counter()
    for w,c in freq.items():
        letters.update({letter:n*c for letter,n in Counter(w).items()})
        for t in spelling_counts(w):
            tri[t]+=c
    sequences=np.asarray(list(tri),dtype=np.int64)
    values=np.asarray(list(tri.values()),dtype=np.float64)
    if not len(sequences):
        raise ValueError('The declared alphabetic channel is empty')
    return sequences,values,letters

def score_all(data,m,model):
    ix,c,_=data
    a,b,d=m[ix].T
    return float(c@model[a,b,d])

def fit_letters(fit,validation,model,plainletters,rng):
    data=prep_literal(fit)
    val=prep_literal(validation)
    samples,c,_=data
    touched=[[np.flatnonzero(np.any((samples==i)|(samples==j),axis=1))
              for j in range(26)] for i in range(26)]
    letter_stock=data[2]
    scored=sorted(range(26),key=lambda n:(-letter_stock[ABC[n]],n))
    decoded=sorted(range(26),key=lambda n:(-plainletters[n],n))
    starting=np.arange(27,dtype=np.int64)
    starting[scored]=decoded
    temperatures=[120.*(.025/120.)**(i/(PROPOSALS-1)) for i in range(PROPOSALS)]
    rank_options=[]
    touched_tables=[[(samples[q].T,c[q]) for q in row] for row in touched]
    for restart in range(STARTS):
        mapping=starting.copy()
        if restart>2:
            fresh=list(range(26))
            rng.shuffle(fresh)
            mapping[:26]=fresh
        elif restart:
            for _ in range(7):
                i,j=rng.sample(range(26),2)
                mapping[i],mapping[j]=mapping[j],mapping[i]
        current=score_all(data,mapping,model)
        bestscore=current
        best=mapping.copy()
        for temp in temperatures:
            i,j=rng.sample(range(26),2)
            (x,y,z),co=touched_tables[i][j]
            before=float(co@model[mapping[x],mapping[y],mapping[z]])
            mapping[i],mapping[j]=mapping[j],mapping[i]
            after=float(co@model[mapping[x],mapping[y],mapping[z]])
            gain=after-before
            if gain>=0 or rng.random()<exp(gain/temp):
                current+=gain
                if current>bestscore+1e-8:
                    bestscore=current
                    best=mapping.copy()
            else:
                mapping[i],mapping[j]=mapping[j],mapping[i]
        exact=score_all(data,best,model)
        assert abs(bestscore-exact)<1e-6
        rank_options.append((score_all(val,best,model),restart,exact,best))
    picked=max(rank_options,key=lambda t:(t[0],-t[1]))
    best=picked[-1]
    assert set(best[:26])==set(range(26))
    return ''.join(ABC[i] for i in best[:26]),dict(restart=picked[1],
       fit_score=picked[2],validation_score=picked[0],
       every_validation_score=[q[0] for q in rank_options],proposals=STARTS*PROPOSALS)

def rectangular_assign(values):
    """Maximize one-to-one scores, with at least as many columns as rows."""
    nr=len(values)
    nc=len(values[0])
    assert nr<=nc
    rp=[0.]*(nr+1)
    cp=[0.]*(nc+1)
    matched=[0]*(nc+1)
    back=[0]*(nc+1)
    for i in range(1,nr+1):
        matched[0]=i
        col=0
        dist=[float('inf')]*(nc+1)
        used=[False]*(nc+1)
        while True:
            used[col]=True
            row=matched[col]
            delta=float('inf')
            next_col=0
            for j in range(1,nc+1):
                if used[j]:
                    continue
                reduced=-values[row-1][j-1]-rp[row]-cp[j]
                if reduced<dist[j]:
                    dist[j]=reduced
                    back[j]=col
                if dist[j]<delta:
                    delta=dist[j]
                    next_col=j
            for j in range(nc+1):
                if used[j]:
                    rp[matched[j]]+=delta
                    cp[j]-=delta
                else:
                    dist[j]-=delta
            col=next_col
            if matched[col]==0:
                break
        while col:
            prior=back[col]
            matched[col]=matched[prior]
            col=prior
    out=[None]*nr
    for col in range(1,nc+1):
        if matched[col]:
            out[matched[col]-1]=col-1
    assert len(set(out))==nr
    return out

class Donor:
    def __init__(self,filename):
        assert digest(filename)==DONOR_HASH
        self.words=normalize(strip_gutenberg(filename.read_text()),'italian').split()[:60000]
        self.freq=Counter(self.words)
        self.preset=' '.join(self.words).encode('ascii')[-32768:]
        self.candidates=sorted((w for w in self.freq if len(w)>=2),key=lambda w:(-self.freq[w],w))[:NUM_CANDIDATES]
        self.transition=defaultdict(Counter)
        for a,b in zip(self.words,self.words[1:]):
            self.transition[a][b]+=1
        self.total_transitions={w:x.total() for w,x in self.transition.items()}
        self.total_freq=len(self.words)+.5*(len(self.freq)+1)
        self.character,self.letter_freq=character_model(self.freq,set(self.candidates[:48]))

    def unigram(self,w):
        return (self.freq[w]+.5)/self.total_freq

    def lift(self,left,right):
        prior=self.unigram(right)
        row=self.transition.get(left)
        count=0 if row is None else row[right]
        p=(count+20*prior)/(self.total_transitions.get(left,0)+20)
        return log2(p/prior)

    def null_plain(self,style,seed,n):
        r=Random(seed)
        ws,weights=zip(*self.freq.items())
        if style=='iid':
            return r.choices(ws,weights=weights,k=n)
        unigram_draws=r.choices(ws,weights=weights,k=n)
        out=[unigram_draws[0]]
        for k in range(1,n):
            transitions=self.transition.get(out[-1])
            if transitions and r.random()>=.08:
                a,b=zip(*transitions.items())
                out.extend(r.choices(a,weights=b,k=1))
            else:
                out.append(unigram_draws[k])
        return out

def fit_dictionary(received,inverse,donor,contextual):
    known=decode_words(received,inverse,{})
    codes=sorted({w for w in received if w.startswith(MARK)})
    code_counts=Counter(w for w in received if w.startswith(MARK))
    priors=Counter(w for w in known if w!='?')
    edges=defaultdict(Counter)
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(received,received[1:])):
        if a.startswith(MARK) and not b.startswith(MARK):
            edges[a][0,known[i+1]]+=1
        if b.startswith(MARK) and not a.startswith(MARK):
            edges[b][1,known[i]]+=1
    rows=[]
    for code in codes:
        values=[]
        for w in donor.candidates:
            p=donor.unigram(w)
            q=code_counts[code]*log2(p)-len(received)*p/log(2)-2*priors[w]
            if contextual:
                for (after,neighbor),n in edges[code].items():
                    q+=n*(donor.lift(neighbor,w) if after else donor.lift(w,neighbor))
            values.append(q)
        rows.append(values)
    return {code:donor.candidates[i] for code,i in zip(codes,rectangular_assign(rows))}

def null_context(received,decoded,donor,seed):
    literal_edges=defaultdict(list)
    marked_set={i for i,x in enumerate(received) if x.startswith(MARK)}
    marked_indices=sorted(i for i in marked_set if decoded[i]!='?')
    for i in marked_indices:
        if i>0 and i-1 not in marked_set:
            literal_edges[i].append((True,decoded[i-1]))
        if i+1<len(received) and i+1 not in marked_set:
            literal_edges[i].append((False,decoded[i+1]))
    tokens=[decoded[i] for i in marked_indices]
    if not literal_edges:
        return None
    scores={i:{w:sum(donor.lift(near,w) if after else donor.lift(w,near)
                      for after,near in literal_edges[i]) for w in set(tokens)}
            for i in marked_indices}
    def statistic(ws):
        return sum(scores[i][w] for i,w in zip(marked_indices,ws))
    value=statistic(tokens)
    r=Random(seed)
    draws=[]
    for _ in range(39):
        transformed=tokens[:]
        r.shuffle(transformed)
        draws.append(statistic(transformed))
    num_edges=sum(map(len,literal_edges.values()))
    return dict(edges=num_edges,greater_tail=(1+sum(x>=value-1e-10 for x in draws))/40,
                mean_bits_gain_per_edge=value/num_edges,
                mean_shuffled_gain_per_edge=mean(draws)/num_edges)

def invert(letters):
    return ''.join(ABC[letters.index(x)] for x in ABC)

def noise(words,code_ids,seed):
    r=Random(seed)
    out=[]
    for w in words:
        if w.startswith(MARK):
            if r.random()<.02:
                out.append(r.choice([v for v in code_ids if v!=w]))
            else:
                out.append(w)
        else:
            out.append(''.join(r.choice([x for x in ABC if x!=c]) if r.random()<.02 else c for c in w))
    return out

def shatter_codes(words,seed):
    r=Random(seed)
    output=words[:]
    for start,stop in ((0,FIT),(FIT,FIT+SELECT),(FIT+SELECT,len(words))):
        pos=[i for i in range(start,stop) if words[i].startswith(MARK)]
        vals=[words[i] for i in pos]
        r.shuffle(vals)
        for i,w in zip(pos,vals):
            output[i]=w
    return output

def accuracy(received,gold,decoded,donor):
    coded=[i for i,w in enumerate(received) if w.startswith(MARK)]
    fallback=[i for i,w in enumerate(received) if not w.startswith(MARK)]
    assert coded and fallback
    char_count=sum(len(gold[i]) for i in fallback)
    exact_chars=sum(sum(a==b for a,b in zip(gold[i],decoded[i])) for i in fallback)
    assert all(len(gold[i])==len(decoded[i]) for i in fallback)
    candidates=set(donor.candidates)
    return dict(tokens=len(gold),coded_tokens=len(coded),fallback_tokens=len(fallback),
                exact_words=mean(a==b for a,b in zip(gold,decoded)),
                exact_code_words=mean(gold[i]==decoded[i] for i in coded),
                exact_fallback_words=mean(gold[i]==decoded[i] for i in fallback),
                exact_fallback_characters=exact_chars/char_count,
                code_candidate_ceiling=mean(gold[i] in candidates for i in coded))

def trial(name,clear,kind,repertoire,seed,donor,noisy_limits):
    planted=Random(seed ^ 0x0AC920)
    key=list(ABC)
    planted.shuffle(key)
    letter_key=''.join(key)
    vocabulary=list(VISCONTI[repertoire]) if repertoire in VISCONTI else planted.sample(donor.candidates[:48],12)
    planted.shuffle(vocabulary)
    dictionary={f'{MARK}{i:02d}':w for i,w in enumerate(vocabulary)}
    clean=encode_words(clear,letter_key,dictionary)
    assert decode_words(clean,invert(letter_key),dictionary)==clear
    take=FIT+SELECT
    output=[]
    for noisy in noisy_limits:
        observed=noise(clean,list(dictionary),seed+9107) if noisy else clean
        if kind=='no_static_code':
            observed=shatter_codes(observed,seed+25017)
        input_fit,input_val=observed[:FIT],observed[FIT:take]
        test=observed[take:]
        gold=clear[take:]
        inverse,run=fit_letters(input_fit,input_val,donor.character,donor.letter_freq,Random(610133+seed%5419))
        decoded_dictionary=fit_dictionary(input_fit,inverse,donor,True)
        baseline_dictionary=fit_dictionary(input_fit,inverse,donor,False)
        decoded=decode_words(test,inverse,decoded_dictionary)
        comparison=decode_words(test,inverse,baseline_dictionary)
        score=accuracy(test,gold,decoded,donor)
        exact=sum(inverse[i]==c for i,c in enumerate(invert(letter_key)))
        recovered_code=sum(dictionary.get(k)==v for k,v in decoded_dictionary.items())
        null=null_context(test,decoded,donor,seed+55289)
        result=dict(work=name,kind=kind,repertoire=repertoire,seed=seed,noisy=noisy,
            code_membership_outside_donor=sorted(set(vocabulary)-set(donor.candidates)),
            spelling_search=run,correct_letters_in_permutation=exact,
            exact_dictionary_entries_in_planted_map=recovered_code,
            total_dictionary_entries=len(dictionary),decoder_dictionary_size=len(decoded_dictionary),
            packet=dict(plaintext_bits=baseline(gold,'raw'),
                donor_plaintext_bits=baseline(gold,'raw',donor.preset),
                ciphertext_zlib_bits=baseline(test,'raw'),ciphertext_dictionary_bits=baseline(test,'vocab'),
                oracle=hybrid(gold,test,letter_key,dictionary,donor.preset),
                blind_proposal=hybrid(decoded,test,invert(inverse),decoded_dictionary,donor.preset)),
            positive_gate=(score['exact_words']>=.90 and score['exact_code_words']>=.80 and
                           score['exact_fallback_characters']>=.95),
            score=score,frequency_baseline=accuracy(test,gold,comparison,donor),marked_context_test=null)
        output.append(result)
    return output

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('donor',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('sources',type=Path)
    args=p.parse_args()
    donor=Donor(args.donor)
    manifest=json.loads((args.sources/'manifest.json').read_text())
    out=[]
    examined={}
    n=FIT+SELECT+TEST
    for i,(work,meta) in enumerate(sorted(manifest['works'].items())):
        path=args.sources/meta['file']
        assert digest(path)==meta['sha256']
        tokens=path.read_text().split()
        assert len(tokens)==meta['tokens'] and len(tokens)>=n+2000
        words=tokens[2000:n+2000]
        assert all(w and set(w)<=set(ABC) for w in words)
        examined[work]=meta
        for p0,repertoire in enumerate(VISCONTI):
            for seed in (471121,481121):
                out.extend(trial(work,words,'author',repertoire,seed+4391*i+993*p0,donor,(False,True)))
        seed=791239+9113*i
        out.extend(trial(work,words,'author','donor_closed',seed,donor,(False,True)))
        out.extend(trial(work,words,'no_static_code','visconti1446',seed+19,donor,(False,)))
        shuffled=words[:]
        Random(seed+292).shuffle(shuffled)
        out.extend(trial(work,shuffled,'word_shuffle','visconti1446',seed+23,donor,(False,)))
        for j,kind in enumerate(('iid','markov')):
            invented=donor.null_plain(kind,seed+719+j,n)
            out.extend(trial(work,invented,kind,'visconti1446',seed+170+j,donor,(False,)))
    data=dict(sources=examined,donor_digest=DONOR_HASH,donor_tokens=len(donor.words),
              donor_candidate_digest=sha256(' '.join(donor.candidates).encode('ascii')).hexdigest(),
              cases=out,representation='visible marked code and alphabetic fallback', search_selector_bits=ceil(log2(STARTS)))
    print(json.dumps(data,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Exact portfolio of framed baseline and mixed-channel packets."""
from hashlib import sha256
from math import factorial
from string import ascii_lowercase

from zlib import compress, compressobj, decompress, decompressobj

ABC=ascii_lowercase
MARK='@'

class Reader:
    def __init__(self,raw):
        self.raw=raw
        self.position=0

    def take(self,n):
        out=self.raw[self.position:self.position+n]
        assert len(out)==n
        self.position+=n
        return out

    def number(self,n):
        return int.from_bytes(self.take(n),'big')

    def text(self):
        return self.take(self.number(2)).decode('ascii')

    def blob(self):
        return self.take(self.number(4))

def integer(i,n):
    return i.to_bytes(n,'big')

def text(w):
    raw=w.encode('ascii')
    return integer(len(raw),2)+raw

def blob(data):
    return integer(len(data),4)+data

def factoradic(order):
    symbols=list(ABC)
    rank=0
    for c in order:
        i=symbols.index(c)
        rank+=i*factorial(len(symbols)-1)
        symbols.pop(i)
    return rank

def unfactoradic(rank):
    symbols=list(ABC)
    result=[]
    while symbols:
        i,rank=divmod(rank,factorial(len(symbols)-1))
        result.append(symbols.pop(i))
    return ''.join(result)

def encode_words(words,letters,dictionary):
    flip={w:code for code,w in dictionary.items()}
    encode=str.maketrans(ABC,letters)
    return [flip.get(w,w.translate(encode)) for w in words]

def decode_words(words,inverse,dictionary):
    trans=str.maketrans(ABC,inverse)
    return [dictionary.get(w,'?') if w.startswith(MARK) else w.translate(trans) for w in words]

def donor_compress(raw,preset):
    obj=compressobj(9,zdict=preset)
    return obj.compress(raw)+obj.flush()

def donor_decompress(raw,preset):
    obj=decompressobj(zdict=preset)
    return obj.decompress(raw)+obj.flush()

def baseline(tokens,mode,preset=None):
    raw=' '.join(tokens).encode('ascii')
    if mode=='vocab':
        vocab=sorted(set(tokens))
        lookup={w:i for i,w in enumerate(vocab)}
        dict_bytes=compress(' '.join(vocab).encode('ascii'),9)
        indexes=compress(b''.join(integer(lookup[w],2) for w in tokens),9)
        packet=b'V'+blob(dict_bytes)+blob(indexes)
        r=Reader(packet)
        assert r.take(1)==b'V'
        vocab2=decompress(r.blob()).decode('ascii').split(' ')
        ints=Reader(decompress(r.blob()))
        assert len(ints.raw)%2==0
        decoded=[vocab2[ints.number(2)] for _ in range(len(ints.raw)//2)]
        assert decoded==tokens and ints.position==len(ints.raw)
    elif preset is not None:
        packet=b'D'+sha256(preset).digest()+blob(donor_compress(raw,preset))
        r=Reader(packet)
        assert r.take(1)==b'D' and r.take(32)==sha256(preset).digest()
        assert donor_decompress(r.blob(),preset)==raw
    else:
        packet=b'Z'+blob(compress(raw,9))
        r=Reader(packet)
        assert r.take(1)==b'Z' and decompress(r.blob())==raw
    assert r.position==len(packet)
    return 8*len(packet)

def hybrid(proposal,received,letters,dictionary,preset):
    assert set(letters)==set(ABC) and len(letters)==len(ABC)
    assert len(set(dictionary.values()))==len(dictionary)
    guessed=encode_words(proposal,letters,dictionary)
    residuals=[(i,w) for i,(a,w) in enumerate(zip(guessed,received)) if a!=w]
    if len(proposal)!=len(received):
        raise ValueError('Proposal length has to match received message slots')
    key_bytes=integer(factoradic(letters),12)
    alphabet_bits=(factorial(len(ABC))-1).bit_length()
    assert alphabet_bits==89
    dict_bytes=integer(len(dictionary),2)
    for code,word in sorted(dictionary.items()):
        dict_bytes+=text(code)+text(word)
    plain_blob=blob(donor_compress(' '.join(proposal).encode('ascii'),preset))
    residual_blob=blob(compress(integer(len(residuals),4)+
                               b''.join(integer(i,4)+text(w) for i,w in residuals),9))
    header=b'H'+sha256(preset).digest()+integer(len(proposal),4)
    packet=header+key_bytes+dict_bytes+plain_blob+residual_blob
    read=Reader(packet)
    assert read.take(1)==b'H' and read.take(32)==sha256(preset).digest()
    count=read.number(4)
    recovered_key=unfactoradic(read.number(12))
    keys={read.text():read.text() for _ in range(read.number(2))}
    replay_plain=donor_decompress(read.blob(),preset).decode('ascii').split(' ')
    assert len(replay_plain)==count
    replay=encode_words(replay_plain,recovered_key,keys)
    corrections=Reader(decompress(read.blob()))
    for _ in range(corrections.number(4)):
        j=corrections.number(4)
        replay[j]=corrections.text()
    assert read.position==len(packet) and corrections.position==len(corrections.raw)
    assert replay==received and replay_plain==proposal and recovered_key==letters and keys==dictionary
    cost=dict(header_bits=8*len(header),key_bits=8*len(key_bytes),
              permutation_information_bits=alphabet_bits,
              explicit_dictionary_bits=8*len(dict_bytes),proposed_plain_payload_bits=8*len(plain_blob),
              residual_bits=8*len(residual_blob),residual_tokens=len(residuals),total_bits=8*len(packet),
              exact_replay=True)
    assert sum(cost[k] for k in ('header_bits','key_bits','explicit_dictionary_bits',
                                'proposed_plain_payload_bits','residual_bits'))==cost['total_bits']
    return cost

def digest(data):
    return sha256(data).hexdigest()


def numeric_entity(match):
    replaced = unescape(match[0])
    if replaced == match[0]:

    return "".join(f"&#{ord(character)};" for character in replaced)


def machiavelli(path):
    paragraphs = []
    book_chapters = []
    with ZipFile(path) as archive:
        package = ET.fromstring(archive.read("OEBPS/content.opf"))
        files = {item.get("id"): item.get("href") for item in package.find(OPF + "manifest")}
        spine = [files[item.get("idref")] for item in package.find(OPF + "spine")]
        assert len(spine) == 149
        assert spine[5] == "Text/Section0006.xhtml" and spine[-1] == "Text/Section0149.xhtml"
        for file in spine[5:]:
            member = "OEBPS/" + file
            source = archive.read(member).decode("utf-8-sig")
            section = ET.fromstring(re.sub(r"&[a-zA-Z]+;", numeric_entity, source))
            body = section.find(f"{XHTML}body")
            assert body is not None
            if body.find(XHTML + "h1") is not None:
                book_chapters.append([])
            if (heading := body.find(XHTML + "h2")) is not None:
                book_chapters[-1].append(int("".join(heading.itertext()).split()[0]))
            section_prose = ["".join(p.itertext()) for p in body.iter(f"{XHTML}p")]
            assert any(p.strip() for p in section_prose), member
            paragraphs.extend(section_prose)
    assert book_chapters == [list(range(1, length + 1)) for length in (60, 33, 49)]
    assert paragraphs[0].startswith("Ancora che, per la invida natura")
    return "\n".join(paragraphs)

    file = ROOT / source["raw_file"]
    raw = file.read_bytes()
    assert digest(raw) == source["raw_sha256"], file
    if file.suffix == ".pdf":
        raw = subprocess.check_output(["pdftotext", "-enc", "UTF-8", "-nopgbrk", str(file), "-"])
        assert digest(raw) == source["pdf_text_sha256"], file
    if file.suffix == ".epub":
        text = extractor(file)
    else:
        text = extractor(raw.decode("utf-8-sig").replace("\r\n", "\n"))
    tokens = normalize(text)
    assert len(tokens) >= 16_000
    payload = (" ".join(tokens) + "\n").encode()
    output = ROOT / source["file"]
    if output.exists():
        assert output.read_bytes() == payload, output
    else:
        output.write_bytes(payload)
    return dict(source, raw_bytes=file.stat().st_size, tokens=len(tokens), sha256=digest(payload))

import re

import unicodedata
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TEI = "{http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0}"
TRANSLITERATE = str.maketrans({"œ": "oe", "æ": "ae", "þ": "th", "ð": "th", "ȝ": "gh"})


def digest(data):
    return sha256(data).hexdigest()


def normalize(text):
    decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.casefold().translate(TRANSLITERATE))
    stripped = "".join(c for c in decomposed if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return re.findall(r"[a-z]+", stripped)


def gower(text):
    opening = "Of hem that writen ous tofore"
    body = opening + text.split("\n" + opening, 1)[1].split("[End of CONFESSIO AMANTIS]", 1)[0]
    body = re.sub(r"_[^_]*_", "", body, flags=re.S)
    body = re.sub(r"\[[^\[\]]*\]", "", body, flags=re.S)
    return "\n".join(line for line in body.splitlines()
                     if not re.match(r"^\s*(?:Incipit|Explicit)\s", line))


def malory(text):
    body = text.split("\nBOOK I.\n", 1)[1]
    body = body.split("\nEnd of the Project Gutenberg EBook", 1)[0]
    return "\n".join(block for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body)
                     if not re.match(r"\s*(?:CHAPTER|BOOK)\s+[IVXLCDM]+\.", block))


def caesar(text):
    xml = ET.fromstring(text)
    books = xml.findall(f".//{TEI}div[@subtype='book']")
    assert [book.get("n") for book in books] == list(map(str, range(1, 9)))
    return "\n".join("".join(p.itertext()) for book in books[:7] for p in book.iter(f"{TEI}p"))


def juan_manuel(text):
    opening = "Acaesció una vez, que el conde Lucanor estaba fablando en su poridad"
    body = opening + text.split(opening, 1)[1].split("\nEJEMPLO LI\n", 1)[0]
    kept = []
    for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body):
        if re.match(r"^\s*(?:\[\d+\]|(?:ENXEMPLO|EXEMPLO|ENJIEMPLO|EJEMPLO)\s+[IVXLCDM]+\s*$)", block):
            continue
        kept.append(re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "", block))

    return "\n".join(line for line in body.splitlines() if not heading.fullmatch(line))

def main():
    results = {}
    for ident, meta in WORKS.items():
        path = ROOT / meta["raw_file"]
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        assert digest(raw) == meta["raw_sha256"], ident
        if path.suffix == ".pdf":
            raw = subprocess.check_output(["pdftotext", "-enc", "UTF-8", "-nopgbrk", str(path), "-"])
            assert digest(raw) == meta["pdf_text_sha256"], ident
        body = globals()[ident](raw.decode("utf-8-sig").replace("\r\n", "\n"))
        words = normalize(body)
        assert len(words) >= 30_000, (ident, len(words))
        filename = ident + ".txt"
        tokens = (" ".join(words) + "\n").encode()
        (ROOT / filename).write_bytes(tokens)
        results[ident] = {**meta, "file": filename, "raw_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                          "tokens": len(words), "sha256": digest(tokens)}
    manifest = {
        "preprocessing": "Casefold, transliterate œ/æ/þ/ð/ȝ, NFKD, remove combining marks, then maximal contiguous ASCII a–z runs. UTF-8, one space between tokens and final LF.",
        "preprocessing_script_sha256": digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "works": results,
    }
    (ROOT / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                                       encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
